contract:
Desktop officer surfaces in the same file, run AFTER B19-orgs-a.

1. CreateOrgModal (:858; state :868; body :899; Visibility field :1005-1039)
- Replace is_public with two segmented fields. Labels follow invites-spec critic C1, which overrides §5.2.
- 'Who can join': 'Anyone can join' (sub 'Join instantly') · 'Request to join' (sub 'Officers approve requests') · 'Invite only' (sub 'Officers invite members').
- 'Open to': 'All of Indianapolis (IU + Purdue)' (default; use '{campus}' generically when not Indianapolis) · 'IU students only' · 'Purdue students only'.
- Help line: 'Checked against each student's verified school email. Current members stay if you change this.'
- The body sends join_policy + audience and stops sending is_public.
- Map 400 audience_excludes_owner to the server copy.

2. OrgSettingsModal (:1254)
- SettingsTab (:1252) += 'invites' | 'followers'.
- Tabs (:1281-1287):
  - requests shows when isStaff && (org.join_policy==='request' || pendingCount>0);
  - 'Invites' shows for canManage only (owner/admin, invites critic C2 and INVITE_ROLES);
  - 'Followers' shows for canManage only (FOLLOWER_LIST_ROLES, M1d header lines 44-49).
- Org type (:101-115) gains join_policy, audience, hidden.

3. Overview (:1395-1510)
- dirty (:1410-1416) and the PATCH body (:1422-1435) use join_policy/audience instead of is_public.
- Same two fields as create.
- Help line under them: 'Anyone can follow your club. This only sets who becomes a member.'
- Switching to Invite only with pending requests shows '{n} pending requests stay in Requests until you approve or deny them.'
- Hidden org: the policy fields are read-only ('This org is hidden…').
- Read-only member view (:1452-1462): replace the 'Visibility' row with 'Who can join: Anyone / By request / By invitation', 'Open to: All of Indianapolis (IU + Purdue) / IU students / Purdue students' and 'Followers: {n}' (omit when null or below 5).

4. SettingsRequests (:2026-2170)
- Rows with eligible===false show 'Not eligible (Purdue student)' / '(IU student)' by ineligible_reason and hide Approve.

5. Invites tab
- Render <OrgInviteSheet inline> (B25). It opens on the club's followers who aren't members (F3), with empty state 'Nobody follows {org} yet. Share the club's page — people who follow it show up here.'
- Do NOT remove the private-channel member add at :2730-2760. The invites spec calls it 'the raw @handle input pattern', but it is ChannelMembers, not org invites.

6. Followers tab
- Header '{n} followers', with the count hidden below 5 (M1d header line 84).
- List from GET /followers, ordered by the server: first_followed_at desc, id desc (M1d KEYSET block overrides spec §4.1).
- Cursor paging via next_cursor.
- Row sub-line 'Follows since {Mon D}', plus 'Joined {Mon D}' when source==='join'.
- One primary per row: 'Invite to join', disabled with 'Already a member' / 'Invited {Mon D}' / "Can't invite — IU students only" per invite state.
- A secondary 'Remove' with confirm 'Remove {name} from followers? They can follow again.', which calls DELETE /followers/[userId] (critic C4; v1 removal is reversible, per the M1d OFFICER REMOVAL block).
- A failed list read renders LoadFailed with Retry and never '0 followers'.
acceptance: tsc 0; eslint ≤ baseline; rg -n "is_public" src/app/campus/campus-home.tsx → only type fields kept for legacy rows (no sends).
PATCH body under an override contains join_policy/audience and no is_public.

1280px screenshots with overrides: create form, Overview (owner vs mod read-only), Requests with an ineligible row, the Invites tab (followers default list, empty, rate-limited), the Followers tab (list, <5 hides count, failed read, remove confirm).
No real invites, removals or policy changes from agents; Franky sends the first SAE invite himself (invites spec §6 acceptance).
